decisions.reason: The source retains automation for the LinkedIn outbound campaign and does not resume or modify the deferred email campaign.
Using MeetAlfred for the LinkedIn campaign is consistent with the already-active configuration requirement but does not change its configuration or subscription attributes.
The campaign automation decision does not change how HubSpot leads or lists are synchronized to MeetAlfred.
The source does not address silent-lead follow-up workflows and does not resume this deferred requirement.
Keeping the campaign automated through MeetAlfred does not change the Zapier plan, add-on policy, or configuration requirement.
The source selects continued campaign automation but does not alter the procedure for provisioning new MeetAlfred campaigns.
The source does not change the existing obligations to preserve the MeetAlfred integration and existing campaigns.
The source concerns campaign automation and does not change duplicate-status visibility on LinkedIn profiles.
The source does not affect which profile URL format is stored in the CRM.
The campaign automation policy does not change the restrictions on using production leads or identities for testing.
The source retains a MeetAlfred-based campaign but does not resolve, resume, or modify the deferred direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration.
The source does not change the requirement to configure or use a Sales Navigator lead source list.
